At n=2,3,4 over F_2, obtained 8,58,802 idempotents and 6,2184,752640 ordered proper triangles respectively. The rank-211 coefficient at n=3 was 168 and rank-222 at n=4 was 3360; support and cyclic symmetry held in all three tables.
correctness.rationale: Fix P with E=im P and K=ker P. Choosing E and a complement gives the first Gaussian factor times q^(r(n−r)). From PQ=0 the only nonzero blocks of Q map E and K into K. Idempotence requires D=Q|_K to be a projection and C=Q|_E to have image in im D; hence rank D=s, so r+s≤n. For rank u of C (equivalently rank QP), choose its image and then a surjection from E, giving [s choose u]_q ∏_(i<u)(q^r−q^i). For R, its image W must lie in B=ker Q, avoid E, and have dimension t. The space E∩B has dimension r−u; choose the quotient image of W in B/(E∩B), then each of its q^(t(r−u)) lifts complements E∩B within its preimage. Once W is chosen, R must be zero on E and the identity on W; it is freely chosen on a complement of E+W with values in W, giving q^(t(n−r−t)). This yields the combined exponent t(n−t−u) and requires t≤n−r−s+u. The summation bounds and all nonnegative exponents follow; in particular n−t−u≥r+s−2u≥0 in a nonzero term. Three pairwise sum inequalities are necessary directly from the three containments and sufficient by taking u=max(0,r+s+t−n). This check includes zero and identity ranks. The proper-rank cycles have distinct vertices, since a repeated vertex would entail its zero square. The pairwise bounds give maximum floor(3n/2), and the balanced listed ranks attain it. For n=2m and ranks m, u=m is forced, D is the identity on K, C is an isomorphism, and R is the unique projection with image ker Q and kernel E. This gives the stated GL_m factor and full rank of every reverse product by cycling the argument.
residual_risks: Independent finite check is restricted to q=2 and n≤4; arbitrary prime powers and sizes follow from the proof. Counts use ordered triples, not unlabelled cycles or similarity classes.

evidence: Huang counts pairs of arbitrary matrices with AB=BA=0 using a generating series; Ferraz et al. count q^(k(n−k)) idempotent generators of a rank-k left ideal; the compressed graph supplies the zero-product incidence description.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The broader objects in these works do not carry the needed triple-count theorem. Mutual rather than one-sided annihilation in particular rules out the full-rank reverse products in the extremal triangle. A count of isolated idempotents or graphs of outgoing adjacencies does not handle the closure constraint.

evidence: The pair-rank formula specializes at rank PQ=0 to the distribution of r,s and u=rank QP. No inspected result counts rank-t R with im R in ker Q and ker R containing im P. The audited proof determines dim(ker Q∩im P)=r−u and adds the quotient lifting count and projection extensions.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The pair table is a strong input but not the answer: it must be weighted by the joint conditional completion count, which depends on u. Summing independent edge degrees or using a pair marginal without u does not yield closure. At even saturation the usual common-complement/isomorphism count is elementary once the triple constraints have been reduced; its standard counting ingredients are not separately original.

evidence: Đurić–Jevđenić–Stopar, arXiv:1810.02776, §3 pp. 8–9: directed edge iff the previous kernel contains the next image.

Patil–Momale–Jadhav, arXiv:2402.11256, §§1,3 and Theorem 3.8: adjacency is undirected OR of the two zero products, in dimension two. Its proof gives a cyclic one-sided zero-product triangle for fields other than F_2.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Idempotents correspond to complementary image/kernel pairs, so the directed triangle is precisely a cyclic incidence on those pairs; a compressed-graph edge treats arbitrary image/kernel pairs, while the dimension-two undirected graph can also count adjacencies outside the oriented cycle condition. Existence in dimension two does overlap and is not credited as new. Neither inspected graph statement is a full weighted triple census.

value.rationale: Rank-refined directed triangle counts are a natural exact invariant of this idempotent graph beyond single-edge degrees. The result resolves which ranks can coexist in a cyclically noncommutative configuration, quantifies every such profile, and identifies the saturation phenomenon with maximal reverse ranks. The completion step addresses dependent edge constraints, not simply multiplying known pair statistics or relabeling an existing census.
residual_risks: The value is for the exact ordered triangle census; similarity-orbit classification and longer cycles are not resolved.
